comment: Starting points for the new-rule wizard, one per scenario. settings use the Firewall Manager rule fields; needs names the field the user must fill in (Program or LocalPort). note is shown under the template.

templates.name: Game server or host a match (UDP), Private networks only
templates.note: Pick the game or server program; it opens its ports only while it runs. Add the port too if the game's guide names one.

templates.name: Allow a game inbound (TCP), Private networks only
templates.note: For games that host over TCP.

templates.name: Share files with PCs on my network (SMB 445, local subnet, Private)
templates.note: Usually you only need to turn on File and Printer Sharing for Private networks in Windows; this rule limits it to your own network.

templates.name: Reach a development web server from my other devices (TCP 3000, 5173, 8080; local subnet)
templates.note: Traffic to localhost (127.0.0.1) is never filtered by the firewall: you only need this rule to open the server from a phone or another PC on your network.

templates.name: Allow a program inbound from the local network only
templates.note: Good for media servers and remote-play hosts at home.

templates.name: Block a program from the internet (outbound)
templates.note: Never use it on a game, launcher or anti-cheat program: online play stops working.

templates.name: Block an inbound port on every network
templates.note: A block always wins over an allow for the same traffic.
